post_hoc_nearest.note: post hoc: each flagged subfield matched at the grid value whose pooled recall comes nearest the names' (module docstring)

post_hoc_curves.note: post hoc: the control's pooled rates on the unseen test names at every bias, in and out of the lexicon (module docstring); names_minus_best: the names minus the control at the bias of the grid that gives the control its highest rate

post_hoc_decomposition.note: post hoc: 18.1 per subfield = the names' gain over MR6 at D = 0 on the held names + MR6's own loss on them from D = 0 to D*

post_hoc_types.note: post hoc: recall on the unseen test names by type group (MAT, VALUE, other) and lexicon membership; the names minus the control at D*, at the nearest grid value for the flagged subfields, and minus MR6 at D = 0

post_hoc_sign_flip.note: post hoc: exact two-sided sign-flip p over the subfields
